about: Accounts payable autonomy policy. Read once when the process starts. Bills, photos, model output and requests cannot change it. Its SHA-256 goes into every receipt.

levels.run_alone: Agents act without asking anyone, inside the limits below.
levels.run_with_approval: Waits in the owner's approval inbox. Runs only after a recorded decision: who, what, when, policy hash.
levels.never: Refused in code, whatever a bill, a model or a person asks.

allowed_hosts.api.groq.com: Optional Muse Spark Open preview. Off unless GROQ_API_KEY is set.
allowed_hosts.api.meta.ai: Paid Meta Model API. Disabled in this build.
